Symbolic checks verify stochasticity, stationary weights, P^5 positivity, the odd cubic characteristic polynomial, initial correlations, the exact all-lag recurrence/generating function and Green–Kubo variance. The same checks verify that the fitted two-state surrogate diffusion coefficient is 2+sqrt(3) and its ratio to the true coefficient is sqrt(3).

value.rationale: Left/right residence is a natural coarse observable of the paired tent metastability problem. Exact finite-leakage oscillatory correlations, an explicit sign-sum fluctuation variance with finite-time correction, and a quantified failure of a two-state one-step Markov reduction distinguish the original dynamics from the usual small-leakage approximating jump chain. The example is at a published canonical postcritical Markov parameter, not an arbitrary numerical slice; new value is an observable-specific exact benchmark rather than a new transfer spectrum or general CLT. The calibrated symmetric two-state Markov surrogate predicts variance 2+sqrt(3), exceeding the exact value by sqrt(3), an exact error factor with a direct metastability-modeling interpretation.
